author: review-agent
title: Full project review: tests C+, documentation C+, data not fit for training
body:
Principal review of the whole repository (journal #1).

- **Tests: C+.** Many tests passed without executing the solvers; data checks were mixed into the unit run; test runs polluted the audit ledger.
- **Documentation: C+.** Stale commands, the retired Markdown dataset layer still described, skills in mixed languages.
- **Data: NOT fit for training.** grounded-paraphrase injected unstated negative premises into about 64% of the training mix; about 70% of the mix came from one templated corpus; targets were predictable from the CONTEXT block instead of the message.

Consequence recorded then: no corpus qualified, and training stayed prohibited regardless (AGENTS.md rule 3). This review started the test hardening, the documentation fixes, the corpus-audit checker and, after the owner's language decisions, the full data rebuild.

Seeded on 2026-09-29 from the journal and reports; the timestamp is that of the source event.

author: test-agent
title: Test hardening: 508 tests pass and solver-backed tests really execute the solvers
body:
Answer to the review's C+ for tests (journal #2).

- `npm test` passed **508** tests.
- Solver-backed tests execute the native solvers instead of skipping silently.
- Long data tests moved to a separate `npm run test:data`.
- Tests no longer append verdicts to the real audit ledger (`CHATSOP_AUDIT_LEDGER` points at a temporary directory).
- Fixed a bug: the HTTP chat trace now reports reinforcement from the executed packet.

Later counts recorded in the journal as the project grew: 514 pass / 41 skipped (14:01Z), 541/541 (15:39Z), 545/545 (16:51Z), 570/570 plus test:data 28/28 at data-final (19:53Z).

author: agent
title: Two agents paused for a session restart; annotations did not survive
body:
At 17:31Z the evaluation-tooling agent paused before any rebuild (corpora consistent, 545/545 tests green, a noise fix pending the next rebuild) and the data-expansion research agent paused with 150 pilot messages written and annotation pending (journal #58, #59).

After the restart (17:50Z, journal #61) **no annotations had survived**; the two independent annotator tracks were re-run over the 150 pilot messages. Lesson: work kept only in a scratchpad is lost on restart; results must be written to the repository before a pause.

Seeded on 2026-09-29 from the journal and reports; the timestamp is that of the source event.

author: project-history-agent
title: Sharding and git cleanup: one clean commit without files over 50 MB
body:
There is no journal event for this work; this note is reconstructed from the repository and says only what the files show.

- Commit `c55f23b` (2026-09-28 19:47 +02:00, "Sharded large data files, one model language, regenerated corpora") changed 615 files.
- `cleanGitCommit.sh` folds the unpushed local commits into one clean commit that contains no file larger than 50 MB (backup copy and backup branch first, `git reset --soft origin/main`, index rebuilt, size check, one commit, push after confirmation; `--rollback` restores).
- The commit added `datasets_sources/` to `.gitignore` (7 files under it remain tracked). `eval/reports/current/` was already gitignored, so the current reports exist only in the working tree.
- The size rule is in AGENTS.md "Key Paths": large JSONL is stored as `<name>.part-NNN.jsonl` shards through `lib/jsonl-shards.mjs`; `node tools/shard-large-files.mjs --check` and `tests/file-size-limit.test.mjs` enforce it.

Uncertain: who ran the script and with which flags is not recorded.

author: owner
title: Owner: GPU shared that night with small inference models; single-worker rule suspended for that case
body:
Journal #86 (actor `owner-via-orchestrator`): the owner ran 0.5B/1.5B/1.7B inference-only models on the GPU in another session. The single-GPU-worker rule (AGENTS.md direction 2) was suspended for that combination for the night. Training continued in parallel and was to pause only if available RAM dropped below about 15 GB or an unexpected large job appeared. Timings of that run are recorded as shared-GPU.

Consequence: the shared unified memory later triggered the training container's CUDA-free floor several times (see training-experiments).

Seeded on 2026-09-29 from the journal and reports; the timestamp is that of the source event.

author: llm-jobs-agent
title: LLM batch work runs as LLMJobs job specs; tiers by configuration; proxy enforces budgets and tags (implemented)
body: Implementation of the owner decisions of 2026-10-02: (1) every LLM batch job is a declarative spec run by deterministic code (LLMJobs/, self-contained and reusable; ChatSOP's jobs, templates and plugins in jobs/); agents read only summary.md (<=10 lines) and escalations.jsonl. (2) Jobs name tiers or roles only: planner and decider good (deepseek-v4.1-flash), auditor medium (v4-flash), worker small (openference Qwen3.8 27b), worker-short tiny (local Qwen3-4B); concrete fallback chains in jobs/llmjobs.config.json until the proxy serves a tier. (3) Adaptive tiers: ladder per task kind, per-item climbing, start tier learned from the append-only state/llm-jobs/tier-stats.jsonl, periodic re-probe of a cheaper tier. (4) Work hygiene: every run writes only state/llm-jobs/<job>/<run-id>/; append-only index; published summaries go to dated run-named paths. (5) LLMAPIProvider refuses a registered run at its budget (402) and untagged or unknown-purpose requests beyond 100 per day (403). (6) Large inputs with instructions run as tasks: one planner call over templates, deterministic plan validation, execution, storage through the existing store path. Fixed shared summary.md writers found: tools/eval/kbqa/report.mjs, tools/eval/pragmatics/run.mjs, tools/eval/query-model-calibration/report.mjs, tools/linking/core-en/summary.mjs (and the cumulative books-eval/index.md); listed in TODO.md, not changed (not owned).
